What complex number is represented in the Argand diagram above?
feedback.worked_solution:
The coordinates of the point are $(0,-2).$

- The real part of this complex number is $x=0,$ and

- the imaginary part is $y=-2.$

Therefore, the number depicted is $z=0-2\text{i},$ which can be simplfied to $z=-2\text{i}.$
